question: A 300-m-long train is running at a speed of 108 km/h. How long will it take to clear a 600-m-long platform?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of train (L₁) = 300 m

Length of platform (L₂) = 600 m

Speed of train (S) = 108 km/h

**Formula used:**

Time (T) = Total Distance / Speed

Total Distance = L₁ + L₂

Speed in m/s = Speed in km/h × (1000 / 3600)

**Calculations:**

Total Distance = 300 + 600 = 900 m

Speed in m/s = 108 × (1000 / 3600)

⇒ Speed in m/s = 30 m/s

Time (T) = Total Distance / Speed

⇒ T = 900 / 30

⇒ T = 30 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is option (4).**
